question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 'through'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look into the meaning of the given options:

 
 
• **through:** moving in one side and out of the other side (of an opening, channel, or a location).
 
• **for:** intended to be given to.
 
• **to:** approaching or reaching.
 
• **of:** expressing a relationship between a part and a whole.
 
 
 
• ​The given blank needs a word that travels crossing the tiny aerosol particles.
 
• Thus, the correct word to fit here would be** 'through'.**

The complete passage is: *The coronavirus (1) spreads mostly through droplets that people send (2) out when they talk, sneeze, or cough. These usually don't stay in the air (3) for long and they don't go farther than six feet. But the coronavirus might also travel (4) through tiny aerosol particles that can linger in the air for up to three hours and travel father away. You might also catch the coronavirus if you touch something an infected person (5) has touched and then touch your eyes, nose or mouth.*
